Humana is hiring a Big Data Software Engineer to develop, test, maintain, and improve software solutions that support business objectives. The role focuses on software quality, defect resolution, performance optimization, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software applications and systems
Establish and uphold software quality assurance standards, processes, and best practices
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex software defects, bugs, and performance issues
Analyze technical problems and recommend corrective actions to improve software functionality and user experience
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product management, quality assurance, and business stakeholders, to deliver effective solutions
Translate business and operational requirements into technical designs and software features
Ensure software solutions align with departmental, segment, and organizational strategies and objectives
Monitor application performance and proactively identify opportunities for optimization and automation
Follow established development standards, processes, and governance requirements while contributing ideas for continuous improvement
Exercise independent judgment in completing assignments, navigating occasional ambiguity, and escalating issues when appropriate
